consent_body: Suraksha respects your privacy. We NEVER transmit your message text or personal contact details. Only the scam type, district, and hashed indicator (e.g. phone or UPI handle) are submitted to warn fellow citizens.
offline_queue_msg: Report saved offline on this device. It will automatically upload when internet connects.
offline_badge_notice: External links require internet connection. Emergency helpline 1930 & local offline tools are fully operational.
home_sub: Instantly detect scam SMS, fraudulent calls, and deceptive UPI QR codes.
check_sub: Verify suspicious messages, phone calls, or payment QR codes with offline AI.
learn_sub: Learn essential digital payment safety rules and boost your score.
video_section_desc: Watch these short educational videos to recognize online fraud and protect yourself and your family.
video_1_title: UPI & Digital Payment Safety (UPI PIN & QR Fraud)
video_1_desc: Learn how fake QR codes and collect request frauds operate. Remember the golden rule: You never need to enter your UPI PIN to receive money.
video_2_title: OTP, Phishing & Fake Bank KYC Scams
video_2_desc: Official warning from I4C Director on deceptive KYC updates, malicious links, and caller tricks designed to steal one-time passwords.
video_3_title: How to Report Cyber Fraud on NCRP & Helpline 1930
video_3_desc: Step-by-step guide on how to register complaints on cybercrime.gov.in and immediately call 1930 within the golden hour to freeze stolen money.
help_sub: Official government reporting paths and emergency financial recovery.
help_lost_desc: Call 1930 immediately within 1-2 hours of fraud. This freezes the beneficiary bank account across India.
help_suspect_desc: If an attempt was made without money loss, report the scammer phone number on Chakshu (Sanchar Saathi) to block their SIM.
eval_desc: Hardened multi-category evaluation benchmark performance (100 independently labelled samples across English, Hindi, Hinglish & Chhattisgarhi evaluated against real-world hard negatives & subtle scams).
chk_utr_desc: 12-digit reference number from bank SMS or UPI passbook statement
chk_amt_label: Exact Amount, Date & Time of Debit
chk_amt_desc: Exact rupees lost and transaction minute for freezing beneficiary bank
chk_num_label: Scammer's Phone Number or WhatsApp ID
chk_num_desc: Phone number or caller ID used to contact you
chk_upi_label: Fraudulent UPI ID / Account Transferred To
chk_upi_desc: The UPI address (VPA) or IFSC/account where money was sent
chk_ss_label: Screenshots of Chat, SMS, or Fake Payment Proof
chk_ss_desc: Keep conversation intact; do not delete SMS or WhatsApp threads
chk_stmt_desc: Proof of unauthorized deduction from your bank or wallet
report_indicator_label: Suspicious Number, Link, or UPI ID (Indicator):
helpline_modal_subtext: Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA / I4C) • 24x7 Toll-Free
helpline_modal_laptop_alert: Laptop/Desktop Notice: Direct cellular calling is not supported on PC. Please dial 1930 immediately from your mobile phone or landline.
helpline_modal_step1: Golden Hour (1–2 hrs): Call immediately after fraud so cyber police can freeze (lien) the stolen funds in the scammer's bank account.
helpline_modal_step2: Keep UTR Number Ready: Have the 12-digit UTR / Ref number from your bank's debit SMS and your account number ready.
helpline_modal_step3: Official Cyber Portal: After calling 1930, submit the formal incident details on cybercrime.gov.in.
helpline_modal_btn_try_pc: 📞 Try calling via PC App (Phone Link / Skype)
crit_step_2: Never enter your UPI PIN or OTP on any screen.
crit_step_3: Do NOT download any remote access app (AnyDesk / APK).
crit_step_4: If money was deducted, call 1930 immediately.
crit_btn_close: Dismiss Warning (I have disconnected the call)
call_speakerphone_desc: Due to Android security restrictions, put incoming calls on loudspeaker so on-device AI can listen and warn in real time.
